Ore and waste movements increased considerably at Yaouré through the year, following mining difficulties faced by contractor EPSA in FY24. While total material mined only increased marginally (1%), mined ore was up by 68%. Yaouré achieved FY25 notional cash flow of US$381 million, producing more than 60% of this (US$230 million) in the second half of the year.
